entry.title: Look around first
entry.body: Sign in to the demo account without registering. It is shared: everyone who signs in sees and edits the same Alerts, and every day at {{time}} it goes back to its example Alerts.
entry.signIn: Sign in to the demo account

banner.shared: This is the shared demo account: every Alert on it belongs to everyone who signs in.
banner.sharedResets: This is the shared demo account: every Alert on it belongs to everyone who signs in, and it resets {{when}}.
banner.others: Its password is published, so other people may be using it right now. Alerts can appear, change or disappear while you look — that is them, not a fault.
banner.reset: Every day at {{time}} the account goes back to its example Alerts, and everything else on it is deleted.
banner.own: To keep Alerts of your own, sign out and create an account.
